description: This PHP source file defines the MediaConfigSubscriber class, which listens to configuration save events for media.settings in Drupal, invalidates cache tags, and triggers route rebuilds when specific settings change.

classes.name: MediaConfigSubscriber
classes.description: A Drupal event subscriber class that listens for configuration save events related to media settings, invalidates relevant cache tags, and triggers route rebuilds when necessary.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the subscriber with route builder, cache invalidator, and entity type manager services.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles the config save event; invalidates cache tags and triggers route rebuilds if 'media.settings' configuration changes, specifically when 'standalone_url' is modified.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the ConfigEvents::SAVE event mapped to the onSave method.
